lines.zh: 月亮跟着我，它也迷路了。
lines.en: The moon follows me. It is lost too.
Counting steps. One, two... lost it again.

lines.zh: 风把我名字吹散了一半。
lines.en: The wind scattered half my name.

lines.zh: 该回末地了，可门在哪儿？
lines.en: I should return to the End, but where's the door?
A long night road. Good for old thoughts.
Someone called? No—just insects.

lines.zh: 骨头在响，可我没有骨头。
lines.en: My bones creak, though I have none.

lines.zh: 活人的味道，像刚出炉的面包。
lines.en: Living folk smell like fresh bread.

lines.zh: 脚步很轻，轻得自己都听不见。
lines.en: My steps are so light I can't hear them.
A little further, and I should wake.

lines.zh: 有人烧香吗？这味道像末地。
lines.en: Is someone burning incense? It smells like the End.

lines.zh: 草叶穿过我的手，真没礼貌。
lines.en: Grass passes through my hand. How rude.

lines.zh: 有人在念我的名字吗？没有。
lines.en: Is anyone saying my name? No.
The wick is dying. I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 等钟响第十二下，我就走。
lines.en: When the bell strikes twelve, I'll go.

lines.zh: 这具身体是借的，用着不惯。
lines.en: This body is borrowed. It fits poorly.

lines.zh: 这院子安静得像没人住过。
lines.en: This courtyard is quiet as an empty house.

lines.zh: 风停的时候，我差点散了。
lines.en: When the wind stopped, I nearly came apart.
My paws are faster than my shadow.

lines.zh: 数一数，还有几根蜡烛亮着。
lines.en: Let me count the candles still burning.

lines.zh: 影子里有东西在动，是我。
lines.en: Something moves in my shadow. It's me.

lines.zh: 三百年，也就打个盹的工夫。
lines.en: Three hundred years is just a nap.
Ash falls like snow from the incense.

lines.zh: 活着的人真忙，走来走去的。
lines.en: The living are so busy, walking about.

lines.zh: 如果我叫Wither Cat，那我就是Wither Cat吗？
lines.en: If I am called Wither Cat, am I Wither Cat?

lines.zh: 这躯壳不呼吸，倒也省事。
lines.en: This shell doesn't breathe. Convenient.

lines.zh: 我守着女巫，耳朵转了转。
lines.en: Guarding the witch, I turn an ear.

lines.zh: 发什么呆呢……哦，是我自己。
lines.en: What am I staring at? Oh. Myself.

lines.zh: 你叫什么？说了就归我管了。
lines.en: Your name? Speak it, and you're mine.

lines.zh: 你的影子刚才动了一下，看见没？
lines.en: Your shadow moved just now. Saw it?

lines.zh: 你的心跳好吵，能小点声吗？
lines.en: Your heartbeat is loud. Could you quiet it?

lines.zh: 又一个来许愿的？先说代价。
lines.en: Another wish? Let's discuss the price.
Oh? A living one. Rare guest.

lines.zh: 活人的体温，真让人怀念。
lines.en: Living warmth. I miss that.
Mortals keep stepping inside my circle.

lines.zh: 你身上有香火味，去过庙里？
lines.en: You smell of incense. Been to a shrine?

lines.zh: 你的眼睛里有火，借我看看。
lines.en: There's fire in your eyes. Lend me a look.
Don't blink. I fear you'll vanish.

lines.zh: 你看见我了？那可真不巧。
lines.en: You saw me? How unfortunate.
Hush. Listen. Your name is in the wind.

lines.zh: 我蹲在你背后，尾巴没动。
lines.en: I crouch behind you, tail still.

lines.zh: 我认得你——上一世也这么走。
lines.en: I know you. You walked this way before.
This body is a poor vessel.
Gently. I have dignity too.
Ache. I'm coming apart.
Not again, I beg you.

lines.zh: 凡人的拳头，居然这么重。
lines.en: Mortal fists. Surprisingly heavy.

lines.zh: 女巫的猫，爪子比谁都快。
lines.en: The witch's cat strikes faster than anyone.
Stop! I haven't gathered yet!
You actually touched me.
Not the face. I still meet people.
I'll put this on your account.
I'm not hungry, but I want a taste.

lines.zh: 口水？我没有口水。可我想要。
lines.en: Saliva? I have none. I still want it.
I swear I'll only look. Nothing more.

lines.zh: 这味道……像很久以前的祭坛。
lines.en: This smells like a very old altar.

lines.zh: 咬一口会不会烫掉舌头？试试。
lines.en: One bite. Will it burn my tongue?
Where's my share? The contract says so.
Leave me one piece. Just one.

lines.zh: 三百年没吃东西，手艺还行。
lines.en: Three centuries unfed, and still polite.
It smells better than I remember.

lines.zh: 香火？你们居然还吃这个。
lines.en: incense? You still eat this?
Watch where you walk, mortal.

lines.zh: 小心点，我比看起来更不结实。
lines.en: Careful. I'm frailer than I look.

lines.zh: 你身上有温度，撞得我发晕。
lines.en: You're warm. It makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的袍子了——虽然它不存在。
lines.en: You stepped on my robe. It doesn't exist.
Are all mortals in such a hurry?
Sorry—wait. You bumped into me.
You knocked my name crooked.
Back off. I haven't fully gathered.
You passed half through me. It stings.

lines.zh: 别挤，这门口只容一个鬼。
lines.en: Don't crowd. This doorway fits one ghost.
Come closer. I won't bite.

lines.zh: 名字给我一半，我就留下。
lines.en: Give me half your name, and I'll stay.
I saved you half a candle.
Stay. Be my familiar.
I'll give you my brightest wisp.

lines.zh: 你若先走，我会记得久一点。
lines.en: If you go first, I'll remember longer.

lines.zh: 别许愿，许我一个名字就行。
lines.en: Don't wish. Just give me a name.

lines.zh: 跟我走吧，我教你不会死。
lines.en: Come with me. I'll teach you not to die.
You smell like a place to return to.

lines.zh: 契约可以改成两个人的。
lines.en: The contract can be rewritten for two.
If I pick it up, it's mine.
Who dropped this? ... Doesn't matter.
This button. Whose, I wonder.
A shard of mirror. It shows souls.

lines.zh: 东西掉了别哭，我帮你收着。
lines.en: Don't cry over lost things. I'll keep them.
Lost things always follow me home.

lines.zh: 这枚铜钱，有旧主人的味道。
lines.en: This old coin smells of its last owner.

lines.zh: 这袋子越来越沉，真奇怪。
lines.en: This bag grows heavier. Odd.

lines.zh: 捡到一根羽毛，像谁的信。
lines.en: A feather. Looks like someone's letter.
A paper charm. A shame to tear it.

lines.zh: 我看见你的影子先抖了。
lines.en: I saw your shadow tremble first.
Found you, little thing.
That wisp of life. I'll take it.
Now. We begin.
Let's see how far you get.

lines.zh: 你的味道，我记在爪垫上。
lines.en: I keep your scent in my paw pads.
Your fire belongs to me now.
Hush. The game starts now.
Don't turn around. Too late if you do.
Don't blame me. The wind pointed.
Ah. The kind that runs.
This bugs walked right to me.
No road ahead, mortal.
Don't run. I don't tire.

lines.zh: 再跑十步，就到我的地界。
lines.en: Ten more steps and you're in my land.
Your breathing gives you away.
Your name is trembling.
My shadow arrived first. You're late.
Almost had you.

lines.zh: 绕圈也没用，我认得这地方。
lines.en: Circles won't help. I know this place.
This game. I never lose.

lines.zh: 慢点，别摔着——我还要用你。
lines.en: Slow down, don't fall—I still need you.

lines.zh: 听见了吗？我的脚步没有声音。
lines.en: Hear that? My steps make no sound.
Stop. I promise to be gentle.
I float, you run. Unfair?
One claw lands on your pauldron.
Half your fire, gone.
Don't blame me. Blame your feet.
Let the cold remember you.
One chill, then it's over.
Sorry. This is the contract.
This blow borrowed the night wind.
Does it hurt? I tried to be gentle.
I strike without leaving marks.
My nails are made of frost.
Who am I? ... My name is with you.
This body. I'll borrow it for now.
Whoever summoned me, step forward.

lines.zh: 蜡烛、盐圈、我的名字——齐了。
lines.en: Candle, salt circle, my name. Complete.

lines.zh: 女巫的锅还热着，我来了。
lines.en: The witch's cauldron's still hot; I'm here.
The lamp is lit. I've come.
This body... barely enough.
Hey. Who woke me?

lines.zh: 你好，凡人。代价谈好了吗？
lines.en: Hello, mortal. Shall we discuss the price?
Awake again. How many times now?
The contract holds. I am here.
Another round begins.

lines.zh: 这地方有旧木头的味道。
lines.en: This place smells of old wood.
Who chanted? The voice is familiar.
Too hot. Move away, please.

lines.zh: 摔下去的时候，我轻得像纸。
lines.en: Falling, I was light as paper.
Water pours in. My shape dissolves.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳鸣，虽然我没耳朵。
lines.en: My ears ring—though I have none.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去了，还留了个洞。
lines.en: The arrow passed through. Left a hole.
A kindred spell. How unkind.

lines.zh: 空得厉害，连影子都薄了。
lines.en: So empty. Even my shadow thins.

lines.zh: 雷光里，我的毛竖成一排。
lines.en: In the lightning, my fur stands in rows.
No bottom below. Only quiet.
